_comment: The Pi task contract for Phase 11's first generated-module workflow. `mm-cli pi run --task bench/pi/module_scaffold_01.json --offline` replays `session_file` instead of spawning the installed `pi` binary, so the gate is deterministic and needs no provider; without `--offline` the same contract is sent to a real session.
goal: scaffold modules/cognition/calibration from the mm-module-scaffold skill
